message:
Mara, Priya and Sam, low stow with high eye keeps start box and sees over load. Folding perception mast lays flat at 0.45 m inside 0.5 m box per stowed versus deployed sketch (E22) and dimensioned stowed sketch (E44) and stands to about 1.0 m eye height, like broom handle folding flat then standing tall. Share is about 1.73 kg per mass sum (E21), like bag of sugar, and about 29 W per power sum (E20), like small bulb, carrying two First Person View (FPV) cameras plus depth sensor and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) meaning motion sensor, bounded by Jetson power data in technical dot city source (E16) and maker electronics source (E18).

Loss of signal means stop not runaway. Heartbeat plus Emergency Stop (E-stop) meaning latching stop holds on link loss, with FPV latency near 80 to 100 ms per RoboMaster sources (E13) and (E14), like fast blink, giving about 0.25 m stopping travel per stopping calc (E19) at crawl speed, about one shoe.

Sensing load stays small for joint proofs. Mass and power fit inside about 53.0 kg reconciled mass per reconciled mass calc (E37) under 60 kg limit, like large luggage, and about 171 Wh sortie energy per sortie energy calc (E32) inside 480 Wh pack for 1.41 h runtime per runtime calc (E36) at 90.6 Wh per kg per pack density calc (E34). I am ready, because mast stow, stop-hold and joint mass-energy close.
